Each team page shows its offense and defense week by week in EPA per play and success rate, opponent-adjusted, with pass and run splits and every game. Records and ranks below are through week 10 of 2026; net EPA per play is offense minus defense allowed, opponent-adjusted. To compare all 32 at once, use the [team efficiency tool](/nfl/tools/team-efficiency.html).
